title: Kicked Peppery Middle Eastern Noodles
description: A spicy and savory vegetarian Middle Eastern dish featuring noodles, a deglazed sauce, and a variety of flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions until they are slightly undercooked
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the sliced onion, cooking until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper, cooking for 1 minute to allow the spices to bloom
Add the vegetable broth to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it has thickened slightly
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley, lemon juice, and salt, and cook for an additional minute
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet, tossing them in the sauce to coat
Use a spatula to deglaze the bottom of the pan, scraping up any remaining browned bits and incorporating them into the sauce
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired
